name: How many JSON-LD script elements should I put on each page and where do they go?

mainEntity.name: How many JSON-LD script elements should I put on each page and where do they go?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need one primary JSON-LD script per page in the <head>, containing only the schema type that matches that page's main content (Product, Article, FAQPage, etc.). Use @graph to include multiple related entities if needed, but never duplicate declarations or mix microdata with JSON-LD on the same page.
acceptedAnswer.description: One primary JSON-LD script per page in the <head>. Match schema type to page content. Use @graph for multiple entities. Never duplicate or mix with microdata.
